mapper.select: SELECT financial_transfer_id AS financialTransferId, origin_id AS originId, retry_of_transfer_id AS retryOfTransferId, status, failure_code AS failureCode, failure_message AS failureMessage, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, requested_at AS requestedAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM financial_transfer WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT financial_transfer_id AS financialTransferId, origin_id AS originId, retry_of_transfer_id AS retryOfTransferId, status, failure_code AS failureCode, failure_message AS failureMessage, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, requested_at AS requestedAt, completed_at AS completedAt FROM financial_transfer WHERE origin_type = 'AUTO_TRANSFER_SCHEDULE' AND origin_id = #{scheduleId} ORDER BY financial_transfer_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT financial_account_id AS financialAccountId, owner_type AS ownerType, owner_member_id AS ownerMemberId, child_id AS childId, account_name AS accountName, account_product_type AS accountProductType, account_status AS accountStatus, link_status AS linkStatus, balance FROM financial_account WHERE financial_account_id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_transfer ( child_id, requested_by_member_id, financial_goal_id, source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount, memo, transfer_type, status, idempotency_key, requested_at, origin_type, origin_id, retry_of_transfer_id ) VALUES ( #{childId}, #{memberId}, #{financialGoalId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{destinationAccountId}, #{amount}, '자동이체 실패 회차 재시도', 'AUTO', 'REQUESTED', #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestedAt}, 'AUTO_TRANSFER_SCHEDULE', #{scheduleId}, #{retryOfTransferId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_account SET balance = balance - #{amount}, balance_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_account_id = #{accountId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND link_status = 'ACTIVE' AND balance >= #{amount}
UPDATE financial_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, balance_updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE financial_account_id = #{accountId} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND link_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_transaction ( financial_account_id, counterparty_account_id, child_id, transaction_fingerprint, occurred_at, direction, amount, balance_after, description, counterparty_name, source_type, synced_at ) VALUES ( #{financialAccountId}, #{counterpartyAccountId}, #{childId}, #{transactionFingerprint}, #{occurredAt}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, #{counterpartyName}, 'AUTO_TRANSFER', #{occurredAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_transfer SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', account_transaction_id = #{debitTransactionId}, credit_transaction_id = #{creditTransactionId}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE financial_transfer_id = #{transferId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'

UPDATE financial_transfer SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE financial_transfer_id = #{transferId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( member_id, child_id, notification_category, notification_type, title, content, reference_type, reference_id, metadata_json, deduplication_key, is_read, created_at ) SELECT #{memberId}, #{childId}, 'SAVINGS', CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'AUTO_TRANSFER_SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'AUTO_TRANSFER_FAILED' END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN '자동이체가 완료되었어요' ELSE '자동이체에 실패했어요' END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN CONCAT( FORMAT(#{amount}, 0), '원이 정상적으로 이체되었습니다.' ) ELSE COALESCE( #{failureMessage}, '자동이체 처리에 실패했습니다.' ) END, 'AUTO_TRANSFER_SCHEDULE', #{scheduleId}, JSON_OBJECT( 'financial_transfer_id', #{transferId}, 'amount', #{amount}, 'status', #{status}, 'failure_code', #{failureCode} ), CONCAT( 'AUTO_TRANSFER_RETRY:', #{transferId}, ':', #{status} ), 0, #{createdAt} WHERE COALESCE( ( SELECT enabled FROM notification_preference WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND notification_category = 'SAVINGS' ), 1 ) = 1
